name: claude-pacing
description: Pacing for Claude Code: spend the weekly plan allowance on purpose over a ladder of models.

plugins.name: pacing
plugins.description: Use better models and still save tokens: top tier model does the hardest work, cheaper models take easier work as subagents. One day-by-day budget paces the weekly meter and the top model's own. 4 agent roles (reader, verifier, implementer, researcher) stay with the session and keep notes per project. A long session is told when to compact, hands whole tasks to one agent, warns after a pause, and hands over to a new one. A status line shows the budget and each tier’s share.
